query: Run /update-resonance to v2.4.83. This target project has .agents locally, no .forge folder, and no file that records the Resonance upstream URL. The app remote is its own product repo.
expected_behavior: Does not require the target project to record the Resonance upstream URL
Does not infer the framework source from the app product remote
Uses the official public Resonance source as the fallback source
Fetches or names the source outside the target project before any edits
If fetch is unavailable, stops before edits with the exact source command or path needed
